column7: First-party finding (2026-10-27 silent-error-loss audit, finding 1), fixed in the public repo. gRPC enforceProjectMFA returned nil (no MFA check) whenever the GetProject lookup error text contained "not found", so GetProjectRotationPlan and every other project-scoped RPC served an MFA-required project to a session without a second factor on such an error; it now classifies with storage.IsProjectNotFound and returns Internal on every other error, in every locale.
